streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan specifies single stream with all reagents dissolved. Concentration 0.1 M from batch input. Flow rate 0.5 mL/min from Engineering Design Calculations Step 3.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan stream_logic indicates all reagents are dissolved together before irradiation. No mixing of separate streams is required.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas carbon tetrachloride solution via sparging with inert gas (N2 or Ar) or membrane degasser to remove oxygen, as radical reactions are oxygen-sensitive (Chemistry Plan).
post_reactor_steps: Collect product stream. Note: Carbon tetrachloride is toxic; ensure proper waste handling.
chemistry_notes: Radical bromination of amino acid derivative using NBS and UV light. Single stream design. Oxygen sensitivity requires degassing. Carbon tetrachloride is the solvent. UV light (365 nm) initiates radical chain. Flow intensification reduces residence time from 8 h to ~12 min. FEP tubing used for UV transparency.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Engineering Design Calculations Step 2 estimated 12.3 min. Analogy 1 showed 48x reduction (180 min to 3.75 min). Analogy 2 showed 60x reduction. Calculated 12.3 min is within the estimated range [6.7-24.0] min and represents a ~39x intensification, consistent with radical halogenation kinetics in flow.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single-phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Batch condition is 30°C. Chemistry Plan does not indicate temperature sensitivity. Maintaining 30°C ensures consistent kinetics.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Design Calculations Step 8 states BPR not required. Solvent bp (77°C) is well above operating temp (30°C). No gas generation.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP is preferred for photochemistry due to high transparency to UV/visible light (Chemistry Plan rule). Analogy 2 used PFA, but FEP is generally more transparent in UV range.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Batch input specifies 0.1 M. Analogy 1 used 0.03 M, Analogy 2 used 0.2 M. 0.1 M is a reasonable compromise and matches batch conditions.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Engineering Design Calculations Step 3 specifies 0.5 mL/min to achieve target residence time with calculated reactor volume.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Engineering Design Calculations Step 3 calculates 6.15 mL based on tau=12.3 min and Q=0.5 mL/min.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: Engineering Design Calculations Step 3 specifies 1.00 mm ID. This is within the recommended 0.5-2.0 mm range for uniform irradiation (Chemistry Plan rule).
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: UV LED array required for radical initiation. Chemistry Plan recommends 365 nm.
reasoning_per_field.wavelength_nm: Chemistry Plan recommends 365 nm for UV light initiation. Analogy 1 used 450 nm (blue), but our reaction specifies UV light.
reasoning_per_field.deoxygenation_method: Chemistry Plan states oxygen_sensitive: true. Sparging with inert gas is standard for radical reactions.
